events.summary: 🎵 You start with a metronome, you end up with a storming beat. Tame wild notes into your beat, converting them into your next note. By the last wave, the storm of sound you composed is taming everything on screen. 🎼 A real sequencer, live, mid-fight One bar. Sixteen steps.
